readability.reads_as: a quick lift and a quicker drop: a pop-up more than a yawn
readability.note: Short form (4.0 s) at k 0.21: rises 0.55 -> 0.78 m (0.5-1.5 s, 0.55 m/s), a 0.4 s hold, then the settle 2.0-2.7 s is the fastest move of the clip (0.70 m/s; J2 80 % accel at 2.5 s). Nothing goes out or across (extent 0.04 x 0.07 x 0.26 m), the wrist roll is small (J6 range 24). A stretch is 'a big slow reach up and out ... then settles': here the settle is a drop.

awkward.evidence: J2 80 % accel, TCP 0.70 m/s, the peak of the clip, in a calm (k 0.21) stretch

audience.note: The lift is vertical in AUDIENCE SIDE (ghosts 4-7) and seen; it stays under 0.8 m.

evidence: 2 big moves, A 1 O 1, dyn x2.48, holds 1, still 24 %, joints 4, lag 0.04 s
timeline: a dip before the rise (A ~0.6 s), the rise (0.55 m/s, 0.5-1.5 s), a 0.4 s hold, then the settle at 0.70 m/s (J2 80 % accel) with a bump past the mark (O ~2.8 s)
the yawn's slow reach is as quick as a pop; extent 0.04 x 0.07 x 0.26 m
expression.note: It has the dip before and the settle after, but the drop is louder than the stretch and the top is hardly held: the arc of a yawn is inverted.
